infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: HF Insights uses your camera to capture X-ray images for AI-based analysis and provide simplified health insights.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: HF Insights accesses your photo library so you can upload X-ray images for analysis and receive easy-to-understand medical insights.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: HF Insights uses the microphone so you can ask questions about your X-ray report by voice.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: HF Insights uses speech recognition to understand your questions about your report.
